title.narrative: Multisectoral and targeted sectoral humanitarian aid for vulnerable categories of IDPs affected by of the conflict in Ukraine, and live in the collective centers of the Rivne region

description.narrative: ltpgtSince the beginning of the full-scale invasion of the Russian Federation, Rivne Oblast has become a home for more than 88,000 internally displaced persons, of whom more than 49,000 are trying to integrate into the life of Rivne Oblast communities. More than 70% are representatives of a vulnerable category of the population (women, children, the elderly, people with disabilities).ltbrgtWith the support of the state and non-governmental public organizations, humanitarian response to critical vital needs was ensured. IDPs lived in schools, kindergartens, hospitals, dormitories of educational institutions, institutions of institutional care and other premises.ltbrgtIn 2022, 73 CSs were operating in the Rivne region. As of 12-31-2023, 53 collective centers are operating.ltbrgtIn the Rivne region, 11 priority collective centers have been identified, which require prioritization of humanitarian response and urgent provision of the conditions of Resolution No. 930 of the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine. The resolution envisages one of the most important sections - ensuring decent living conditions in places of temporary residence. Unfortunately, it is very difficult to provide such conditions in small communities, people with disabilities are dispersed in various collective centers.ltbrgtAlso, taking into account the principles and approaches of planning the activities of collective centers, it is necessary to think strategically and plan the reduction of the number of collective centers. However, it is important to take urgent actions to ensure decent living conditions for IDPs in collective centers and to support the integration and socialization of IDPs. The project offers a globally strategic solution for the Rivne region - consolidation of collective centers in the regional center, where there is greater accessibility to multi-sectoral services. This approach is especially successful for vulnerable categories that do not have access to decent living conditions in small communities. The project proposes to relocate persons with disabilities to one of the priority collective centers (in the city of Rivne), to provide them with access to multi-sectoral protection assistance, and to ensure decent living conditions for people with disabilities and conditions for self-sufficiency.ltbrgtIn addition to creating decent conditions for the implementation of Decree No. 930, the affected population needs multi-sectoral assistance, in particular legal, psychologist services, socio-psychological consultations, as well as assistance in rapid adaptation and socialization, self-reliance and security.ltbrgtAs a result of the project, no less thanltbrgt- 350 IDPs will receive direct benefit from the activity - will receive multi-sectoral protection assistanceltbrgt- profiling of IDPs living in 6 priority collective centers will be carried out,ltbrgt- collective centers of the Rivne region were consolidated and 38 persons with disabilities were relocated (consolidated) to one collective center,ltbrgt- at least 75 people will receive self-employment assistance - employment protection service.ltbrgt- supervisory approaches have been implemented in the system of management, coordination and provision of complex assistance to the affected populationltbrgtThe applicant has official support and assistance from the regional authorities and all social structures of the region, which are involved in providing assistance to IDPs.lt/pgt
